meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说快速导入标准写作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有写好的小说想继续完善或纳入写作工具链
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels into a structured writing workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written novel you want to refine or integrate into a writing toolchain

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你把已有的小说文本（半成品或完本）反向解析成标准的项目目录结构，包括设定、大纲、正文、追踪等，让你可以直接续写。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-import”、“导入小说”、“反向解析”、“导入”、“把我的书导进来”等触发词时，Claude 会启动导入流程。

say.text: 我要导入一本小说，请帮我解析成项目结构。
say.note: Claude 会询问书名、篇幅等信息并开始分析。

say.text: 请反向解析这个文本文件，做成可续写的工程。
say.note: Claude 会按篇幅自动分流，生成完整写作工程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will reverse-parse your existing novel (draft or complete) into a standard project directory structure, including setting, outline, text, tracking, etc., so you can continue writing directly.
howto.when_en: When you say "/story-import", "import novel", "reverse analyze", "import", "import my book", Claude will start the import workflow.

say_en.text: I want to import a novel, please parse it into a project structure.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for book name, length, etc. and start analysis.

say_en.text: Please reverse-parse this text file into a writable project.
say_en.note: Claude will auto-route by length and generate a full writing project.
